before: A host could author a content control only around a range inside one paragraph (insertContentControl). A control around whole paragraphs was read, painted and saved intact, but nothing could write one.
after: wrapBlocksInContentControl { firstBlockId, lastBlockId, tag?, lock? } wraps sibling blocks in a new rich-text block control; insertBlockContentControl { at: { before | after | inside }, tag?, lock?, paragraphs? } writes one at a place between blocks, with the paragraphs given (fresh node and paragraph ids) or a paragraph showing the prompt. Both refuse a revision.
reason: Both ops reduce to one children replacement in the container they write into, which the journal already replicates; released participants receive the resulting shared state, never the new op kinds.
